canonical_query_variants_decision: EXPECTED_EXCLUSIONS: preserve the clean canonical owner, functional form prefill, locale and campaign params; do not publish parameter variants as independent sitemap owners.
other_reasons_decision: NOT_VERIFIED_AT_URL_LEVEL: aggregate-only counts are not independent defects; require separate per-reason URL exports and current live/source inspection before changing code or requesting indexing.
historical_404_context: Existing previously validated seven example URLs include intentional 301/410/405 and Cloudflare-managed 404, but the owner 2026-11-02 aggregate does not prove the exact current seven are identical.
enforcement: Never claim Google indexation from CI or merge. Do not auto-validate or bulk-request indexing.
